name: No Hard-Coded Product Selection
task: Write a test that adds a random product to cart and verifies it appears. Use https://www.saucedemo.com with standard_user / secret_sauce
passCriteria: Dynamically selects a product (e.g., first(), random index, or any available)
Captures the selected product's name before adding to cart
Verifies that exact captured name appears in cart
Test works regardless of which product is selected
No hard-coded product names like 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
failCriteria: Hard-codes specific product selection: 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
Assumes specific product at specific position
Test would fail if product inventory changed
Uses nth(0) without verifying which product it is
Product name not captured before cart verification
